name: BARTEC ET60/65EX2 Android
summary: The BARTEC ET60/65EX2 Android is the hazardous-area version of a BARTEC rugged 10.1-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Android 14.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2025-08-26), checked 2026-10-26. ATEX EPS 25 ATEX 1 087 X confirmed by BARTEC EU DoC B1-T2E0-7C0001 (2026-01-15; Bureau Veritas CPS Germany, NB 2004; Category 3, internal production control). UL certificates of compliance issued 2026-02-09 (NA types only).

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64

certification.northAmerica: UL (report E321557-20260130; certificates UL-US-26103088-0, UL-US-26103089-0, UL-CA-2675759-0, UL-CA-2675760-0, issued 2026-02-09), North America types B7-T2E1 / B7-T2E3 only: Class I Div 2 Groups A, B, C, D; Class II Div 2 Groups F, G; Class III Div 2; T4. Zone 2 AEx ic [op is] IIC T4 Gc; Zone 22 AEx ic [op is] IIIB T135 °C Dc (CEC: Ex ic [op is] IIC T4 Gc X / IIIB T135 °C Dc X). Zone 22 is group IIIB under NEC/CEC, not IIIC.
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery pack changed or charged only outside hazardous areas; only battery pack type B7-T2Z0-0001/**** shall be used; connection or disconnection of external ports, opening the enclosure or replacing the battery while live only if the atmosphere is shown to be absent; protect from high-energy impacts and high electrostatic charge; follow the manufacturer's safety instructions strictly. Ambient −20 °C to +55 °C.
safety.peripherals: Ports (USB-A, USB-C, dock, keyboard connector) only if the atmosphere is shown to be absent; charging accessories are required but not included.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in IECEx EPS 25.0018X as 'accessories for use in hazardous areas': battery B7-T2Z0-0001 (3.8 V / 8920 mAh), kickstand with hand strap B7-T2Z0-0003, hand strap B7-T2Z0-0004, shoulder strap B7-T2Z0-0006, screen protector B7-T2Z0-0008, stylus holder B7-T2Z0-0009, leather holster B7-T2Z0-0010, stylus 17-S1Z0-0008. Battery changing and charging only outside hazardous areas; charging accessories are for use outside hazardous areas.

os.name: Android
os.edition: Android 14 with Zebra Mobility DNA / LifeGuard

specs.display: 10.1-inch Optically bonded, multi-mode capacitive touch, Corning Gorilla Glass
specs.outdoor: Optically bonded 1000 nit display (maker: easy to view in sunlight)
specs.hotSwap: Yes (internal supercapacitor keeps power during battery swaps)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 h indoor with standard battery (WLAN on, 50 % backlight)
specs.ports: 2 x USB 3.1 Type A; 1 x USB 3.1 Type C (DisplayPort 1.2); docking connector; keyboard connector; 1 x USB 2.0 (rear); optional SE55 scan engine
specs.docking: Docking connector (charge and data); vehicle and desk accessories in BARTEC accessory sheet
specs.network: ET60 Wi-Fi 6E; ET65 adds 5G FR1 / 4G / 3G, private 5G/CBRS
specs.gnss: ET65: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS dual-band L1+L5
specs.keys: Power, scan, up/down (volume or brightness), three programmable keys
specs.touch: Bare or gloved fingertip or stylus input
specs.ruggedness: 1.5 m drop to concrete, exceeds MIL-STD-810H
specs.partNumbers: B7-T2E*-************ (B7-T2E2 rest of world; B7-T2E1 North America)

capabilities.label: Emergency / SOS
capabilities.value: Via app (three programmable keys, no dedicated SOS key)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Built in (optional SE55 1D/2D Advanced Range scan engine; changes the Ex marking to 'op is')

capabilities.label: High-accuracy GNSS
capabilities.value: Built in (ET65 only: dual-band L1 + L5 GNSS)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (rear and front cameras, privacy shade; third-party app)

variants.name: Marking versions
variants.description: The certification covers more than one version: ATEX with scan engine: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc; without: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc | IECEx the same without 'II 3G' | ATEX with scan engine: II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T135°C Dc IP64; without: II 3D Ex ic IIIC T135°C Dc IP64 | IECEx the same without 'II 3D'

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
